items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: he could play with him all the time... what he used to play with the band in Thibodeau

ctx.x: Well, he usually get this little fella, George Lewis. He had the only lad, George Lewis, he could play with him all the time.
That's what George told me he played since I was.
Yeah. And he used to use the fella for what he used to play with bass drum, what he used to play with the band in Thibodeau. Oh. Clay.
